services.name: Private Sailing Cruise
services.desc: Have you ever experienced a sailing adventure aboard a two-hull sailboat? Rates Private Charters $1,500 for Day Cruises. $35 each additional passenger Available Times 7 Days a Week 10:00am Duration 2 Hours About Two hulls provide stability for a smooth ride without leaning to one side. Come enjoy a two-hour sail aboard the Cetacean, a 52-foot Hawaiian catamaran. With the wind in our sails, the Cetacean skims along the waters of Orange Beach, Alabama and Perdido Key, Florida. While out sailing, you’ll see coastal wildlife and marine life all around. Take in the sights and sounds as pelicans and cormorants dive into the water; bald eagles, egrets, sea gulls, herons and osprey fly nearby;

services.name: Dolphin and Nature Cruise
services.desc: This is the most popular cruise we offer. Available Times 7 Days a Week Check calendar for times and availability Duration 2 Hours About Our two-hour dolphin and nature cruise combines all the features of the dolphin cruise with extra floating time through the hidden creeks of the back bays. We spend the first hour locating and observing our local dolphin pod, and we spend the second hour far up in the swamps. Our knowledgeable tour guide and captain will point out the local flora and fauna. You may see osprey and their nests, herons, bald eagles, red-tailed hawks and maybe even an alligator or two.
